_meta.description: Parametric design templates for common 3D printable objects. Each template provides OpenSCAD code with customizable parameters.

phone_stand.description: Angled phone stand with adjustable cradle width, angle, and base dimensions. Prints upright, no supports.

hook.description: Wall hook with screw hole. Prints on its side as an extruded profile — no supports, layer lines wrap the J for strength.

cable_clip.description: Adhesive-back cable clip for desk cable management. Prints flat.

shelf_bracket.description: Triangulated shelf bracket with mounting holes. Prints upright.

drawer_organizer.description: Grid-based drawer organizer with customizable compartments. Prints flat.

sd_card_holder.description: Desktop holder for SD and microSD cards in two rows of top-opening slots; cards stand proud for easy grip. No supports.

coat_hook_multi.description: Wall-mounted coat rack with multiple pegs. Prints flat on its back, pegs up, no supports.

hinge_box.description: Box with living hinge that prints as one piece, folds to close.

funnel.description: Kitchen/workshop funnel with customizable spout and mouth sizes.

measuring_scoop.description: Kitchen measuring scoop: cylindrical cup holding exactly the set volume when filled level, with a flat handle. Prints without supports.

wall_plate_cover.description: Standard wall plate cover for light switches or outlets.

soap_dish.description: Draining soap dish with raised ridges in the basin and a protruding front-center drain spout that channels water off the front edge.

ridge_count.description: Number of raised drain ridges in basin

spout_width.description: Width of the protruding drain spout

spout_length.description: How far the drain spout extends beyond the front edge (set to 0 for no spout — closed basin)

spool_holder.description: Tabletop filament spool holder with roller bearings and adjustable width.

tube_connector.description: Parametric tube coupler for joining pipes or tubes. Straight or angled.

battery_holder.description: Battery tray for AA, AAA, or 18650 cells. Snap-in trough lips and a finger scoop; prints without supports.

wrench.description: Open-ended wrench for hex bolts. Specify the bolt size.

spacer_washer.description: Flat spacer ring with configurable inner diameter, outer diameter, and thickness.

corner_brace.description: L-shaped reinforcement bracket with mounting holes for joining perpendicular surfaces.

standoff.description: Hexagonal standoff with through-hole for PCB or panel mounting.

shaft_collar.description: Clamping collar for locking position on a round shaft. Split design with bolt hole.

pcb_standoff_mount.description: Mounting plate with standoff posts for standard PCB sizes. Configurable hole spacing.

din_rail_clip.description: Snap-on DIN rail mount adapter for custom modules. Standard 35mm rail.

servo_bracket.description: L-bracket for standard hobby servo motors with mounting tabs.

stackable_bin.description: Stackable storage bin with interlocking lip and a card-pocket label holder. Prints without supports.

threaded_jar.description: Jar with a real swept helical screw thread and a lid with the matching internal thread. Two-piece print, threads engage with 0.25 mm radial clearance.

monitor_riser_shelf.description: Monitor riser shelf. Prints upside down (shelf on the bed, legs up), no supports; flip over to use.

tablet_stand.description: Adjustable-angle tablet or e-reader stand with a cable pass-through notch. Prints upright, no supports.

drill_bit_holder.description: Block with graduated holes for organizing drill bit sets by size.

hex_key_rack.description: Wall-mount rack with graduated slots for Allen key sets.

sanding_block.description: Ergonomic sanding block with clip grooves for sandpaper retention.

bag_clip.description: Bag clip in two flat parts: fold-over clip with living hinge, plus a slider ring that locks it shut. Prints flat, no supports.

spice_jar_rack.description: Tiered step rack for uniform spice jars. Configurable jar size and count. Prints without supports.

bottle_opener.description: Lever-style bottle cap opener with ergonomic grip.

filament_guide.description: Filament guide that slides onto printer frame extrusions. Prints flat as an extruded profile, no supports.

nozzle_rack.description: Small organizer block with labeled slots for spare printer nozzles.

cable_raceway_clip.description: Snap-in cable clip. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports, with layer lines wrapping the C for spring strength.

cable_grommet.description: Desk grommet ring with cable slot and snap ring. Prints flange-down, no supports.

gopro_mount.description: Standard GoPro 3-finger mount base with teardrop pivot hole. Prints without supports.

vesa_adapter.description: Adapter plate converting between VESA 75mm and 100mm mounting patterns.

rail_clamp.description: Split-ring rail clamp with cross bolt and mounting pad. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports.

plant_label_stake.description: Pointed garden stake with raised-text label. Prints lying flat, so soil-push loads run along the layers.

pot_drip_tray.description: Saucer/drip tray sized for specific pot diameters.

seed_spacer.description: Flat template with configurable hole grid for consistent seed spacing.

phone_vent_mount.description: Car vent phone mount in two flat parts: cradle plus a vent fin that locks through the cradle's slot. No supports.

fuse_puller.description: Tweezers-style tool for extracting automotive blade fuses.

corner_clamp_jig.description: Alignment jig for holding pieces at exact 90 degrees during gluing or welding.

bench_dog.description: Bench dog with friction-fit spring slot. Prints head-down with a 45-degree flare, no supports.

hose_barb_adapter.description: Barbed fitting adapting between two hose diameters. Diamond barbs and coned transitions print support-free.

drain_strainer.description: Drain strainer with radial slots and a coned rim that self-centers in the drain. Prints without supports.

raspberry_pi_case.description: Two-part Raspberry Pi case; base and lid print side by side with open faces up, no supports. Standoffs follow the official 58x49mm hole pattern.

switch_panel.description: Flat panel with configurable cutouts for toggle or rocker switches.

p_trap_cover.description: Snap-fit cover plate for exposed P-trap pipes under sinks. Conceals plumbing cleanly.

shower_caddy_hook.description: Over-the-pipe hook for hanging shower caddies or accessories on shower pipes.

cable_chain_link.description: Snap-together cable chain link with an open cable channel and pivot pins. Prints floor-down, no supports.

cable_wrap_guide.description: Cable spool in two parts printed side by side; the mounting screw clamps the top flange onto the hub. No supports.

clamp_pad.description: Soft jaw pad that slips over metal vise jaws. Prints face-down, no supports.

dowel_jig.description: Self-centering dowel drilling jig for precise joint alignment. Multiple hole spacing options.

birdhouse_panel.description: Birdhouse front panel with entry hole and integrated perch. Prints flat on its back, no supports.

gear_spur.description: Involute spur gear with configurable tooth count, module, and face width. For hobby robotics and mechanisms.

pulley_gt2.description: GT2 belt timing pulley for 3D printers and CNC. Configurable tooth count and bore.

z_axis_guide.description: Adjustable Z-endstop mount for 3D printer frames. Slides on 2020 extrusion.

tool_holder_pegboard.description: Customizable pegboard hook for holding tools, cables, or accessories. Standard 25mm pegboard spacing. Prints flat, no supports.

fridge_magnet.description: Flat magnet holder in rectangle, square, circle, or oval shapes with recess for a standard disc magnet. Front face is decoration-ready for photos, logos, or text.

shape.description: Shape: rectangle, square, circle, or oval

fridge_magnet.preview_notes: Flat object — front/back faces are top and bottom. Show top (decoration face) and bottom (magnet recess) at priority.

bookmark.description: Thin flat bookmark with optional page clip and decoration-ready face. Designed for thin-wall printing.
bookmark.preview_notes: Flat object — both large faces are decoratable. Show top and bottom faces, not thin edges.

pen_cup.description: Desktop pen/pencil holder in cylinder or rectangular shape. Flat outer walls for decoration (logo, text, photo). Bottom has a recessed QR code pocket matching the proven coaster recipe.

depth.description: Depth/length for rectangular shape (ignored for cylinder)

qr_pocket_size.description: QR code pocket size on bottom (0 = no pocket). Must be less than 75% of diameter.

qr_pocket_depth.description: QR pocket recess depth (matches coaster recipe)

pen_cup.preview_notes: 3D object — isometric for shape, front for decoration wall, bottom for QR pocket, top for opening.
